parsed.summary: The PR improves autoreloading detection but introduces potential issues with `__main__.__spec__` being `None`.

issues.description: The change assumes `__main__.__spec__` is always set, which may not be true in all environments, leading to potential runtime errors.
The PR does not include tests to verify the new autoreloading behavior in different Python environments and scenarios.
